description: Internal logging subsystem declarations for Zephyr RTOS, including structures, function prototypes, and inline functions related to log message handling, drop notifications, filters, and domains.

methods.name: z_log_dropped
methods.description: Indicates to the log core that a log message has been dropped, with a boolean indicating if it was buffered.

methods.name: z_log_dropped_read_and_clear
methods.description: Reads and clears the current drop count.

methods.name: z_log_dropped_pending
methods.description: Checks if there are pending drop notifications.

methods.name: z_log_links_activate
methods.description: Activates specified log links based on a mask and offset.

methods.name: z_log_notify_backend_enabled
methods.description: Notifies that a log backend has been enabled.

methods.name: z_log_dynamic_filters_get
methods.description: Returns pointer to filter set for a given log source ID.

methods.name: z_log_sources_count
methods.description: Returns the number of registered log sources.

methods.name: z_log_ext_domain_count
methods.description: Returns the number of external log domains.

methods.name: z_log_msg_claim
methods.description: Claims a pending log message, with backoff for ordering.

methods.name: z_log_msg_pending
methods.description: Checks if there are pending log messages.

methods.name: z_log_is_local_domain
methods.description: Checks if a domain ID is local.
